primaryTextRead.text: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.

wikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
wikipediaRead.locator: L1369–1373 distinguishes four men; the final bullet identifies the prefect of Ahaz’s house killed by Zichri in 2 Chronicles 28:7.
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版の人物一覧は、歴代誌下28:7の王家の家令アズリカムを、同名の別人と分けて挙げています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The final bullet explicitly names the prefect in 2 Chronicles 28:7 and distinguishes three other Azrikams.
